annotation.name: @no_mangle
annotation.description:
Marks the following named declaration as excluded from export-time mangling or rewriting done by wgodot. For constants, this prevents de-const export processing from inlining the constant value and removing the constant metadata. The constant remains visible in exported scripts and in [method Script.get_script_constant_map]. For classes, functions, and properties with getter/setter bodies, this acts recursively for declarations inside that subtree: wgodot skips name obfuscation and does not remove constants declared inside the subtree. Usages inside the subtree still follow the declaration they reference; for example, a use of an outside private field is renamed if that outside field declaration is renamed. This annotation can be used on classes, constants, functions, enums, signals, and variables. It is also accepted on local constants and variables inside functions. [codeblock] @no_mangle const API_ENDPOINT = "https://example.com"
func example(): @no_mangle const DEBUG_LABEL = "debug" [/codeblock]

annotation.name: @override
annotation.description: Marks the following instance method as intentionally overriding a method inherited from a base class. When [code]wgodot/gdscript/strict_override_checking[/code] is enabled, overriding an inherited method requires [annotation @override]. Marking a method that does not override any inherited method is an error. [codeblock] @override func _ready() -> void: pass [/codeblock]

annotation.name: @obfuscate
@partial
@private
@protected
@readonly
@static_class
annotation.description:
Marks the following class as a static utility class. Static classes cannot be constructed or used as type hints. They cannot use inheritance or interfaces, and their members must be static or constant. [codeblock] @static_class class MathHelpers: const SCALE = 100
static func percent(value: float) -> float: return value * SCALE [/codeblock]
